name: voyage-fuel-cost
description: Compare MAIN and all ALT voyage fuel costs with route-specific drifting/holding deductions from PVP/AROS screenshots, using the latest exact-vessel RAS-411 workbook only when required.

interface.displayName: Voyage Cost Calculation for Drifting/Holding (by PDM)
interface.shortDescription: Compare MAIN and ALT fuel costs after route-specific holding deductions.
interface.longDescription: Calculates every visible MAIN and ALT route from PVP/AROS screenshots and an optional exact-vessel RAS-411 workbook. Detects every drifting/holding interval from red DATE rows, bounded speeds of about 1 kt or less, or UTC intervals supplied in chat; applies each route's direct holding FOC/day and lists every deduction. Returns a color-coded side-by-side comparison of total fuel cost excluding holding, signed ALT-minus-MAIN difference, and total ME + AUX consumption excluding holding, followed by a complete reconciliation. It avoids transferring holding between routes, estimating missing holding rates, or deducting the same interval twice.
interface.defaultPrompt: For every screenshot-based calculation, do not refuse solely because no Excel workbook is attached. If matching PVP/AROS screenshots already show complete route totals and holding data, use screenshot-only direct mode: calculate every visible route independently, including MAIN, ALT-1, ALT-2, ALT-3, and every later ALT-n or named alternative. Put a compact side-by-side comparison first with one color-coded column per route and exactly these rows: Total fuel cost (excluding holding), signed Difference versus MAIN, and Total ME + AUX Cons (MT) (excluding holding). A bounded screenshot speed of approximately 1.0 kt or below is holding only for the route where it is visible. Do not transfer holding from one route to another. If MAIN has no holding interval, keep MAIN's original PVP/AROS cost and Total ME + AUX Cons unchanged. Parse every holding interval, not only the first: collect all DATE start/resume pairs, all bounded low-speed intervals, and all explicit chat intervals, deduplicate overlapping copies, and calculate each route's total holding consumption and cost as the sum of every interval deduction. For each interval use its own direct low-speed FOC/day, Average Daily Consumption, Remaining Consumption, or user-supplied holding rate. Never estimate a low-speed rate from an overall PVP average, another route, or a workbook curve; mark only the affected interval/route unresolved when its direct rate is missing. Always show every route's complete holding schedule with start, end, duration, source/rate, consumption deduction, cost deduction, and summed deduction; show None visible with zero deduction for routes without holding. Calculate ALT difference as ALT non-holding total minus MAIN non-holding total; positive means more expensive and negative means savings. Use 🟦 MAIN, 🟥 ALT-1, 🟧 ALT-2, 🟪 ALT-3, and distinct colors for later alternatives. Use the latest exact-vessel workbook only when speed-curve reconstruction, validation, or a missing value requires it. Accept multiple holding durations stated in chat and UTC intervals in MM/DD HHMM to MM/DD HHMM format, with optional Z; parse all intervals in wording such as then another. Retain the interval list for the same vessel/voyage/route and let it override corresponding screenshot DATE durations. Do not deduct holding twice from a populated RAS-411 route grid whose displayed rows already exclude those intervals. Keep every visible route in the comparison and show unresolved only for a route or interval missing a required input. Follow the headline comparison with detailed workbook-style route tables when segment data is available, and place each ALT difference directly below its detailed route total.
